name: Suzunae Houmi
source:
Houmi is the daughter of the school principal and is also the protagonist’s classmate, she is a gentle girl who exudes a calming aura. Since she appears so perfect, the male students call her a goddess and almost worship her. However, she’s really a very friendly and playful girl who likes to play jokes on people sometimes. Her dream is to become a good wife for her certain someone.

[Edited and taken from [url=http://liemyx.wordpress.com/2011/09/20/previewstrawberry-nauts/]Liemyx's preview[/url]]
